items.topic: Relation setter set<Relation> needs a value; use unset<Relation> to clear
items.claim: Report claimed: generated relation setters NPE on null relatedObject
items.fact: Only single-relation set<Relation>(object, relatedObject) calls relatedObject.identifier() without null check (fragment.dao.single.relation.implementation.mapped.java.hbs:193). Clearing is via unset<Relation>(object) (line 202, generated when unset allowed). add/remove on multi relations call identifier() per element so null elements fail. This is by-design: null/absent/empty are distinct in JUDO; document 'set needs a value, use unset', not 'setters throw on null'.

items.topic: Generated DAO query<Attribute>() casts enum value directly -> ClassCastException (Integer ordinal)
items.claim: Querying enum-typed relation may randomly return raw Integer
items.fact: Deterministic: DTO getter (dto.java.hbs:256-259) converts stored Integer via Enum.getByOrdinal(ordinal); DAO query<Attribute>(id,param) (fragment.dao.query.attribute.implementation.mapped.java.hbs:13) casts the stored value straight to declared type, so enum attributes throw ClassCastException. Methods are generated for self.allTransferAttributesForQuery (parameterised-query attributes) which explains why only some projects hit it. Generator bug; expected: convert via getByOrdinal.

items.topic: BooleanFilter has no isUndefined; use filterBy(String customFilter) with JQL !isUndefined()
items.claim: 'No is-unset filter for nullable booleans; query cannot be expressed'
items.fact: Typed BooleanFilter only has isTrue() ({0}) and isFalse() ((not {0})) (judo-sdk-common BooleanFilter.java/BooleanOperation.java). Escape hatch: query builder filterBy(String customFilter) takes raw JQL, which has !isUndefined()/!isDefined(). Boolean is three-state: absent/null/value.

items.topic: Absent vs null vs empty are distinct states in JUDO generated API
items.claim: Reference for generated getter semantics
items.fact: Generated getters depend on required: required=true -> plain type getter (Boolean getMinimumOfferPriceEnabled()), where null means caller omitted the field (error); required=false -> Optional<T> getter (Optional<FileType> getReviewReportMarkdownTemplate()). DTO getters check containsKey, so key-missing vs present-null differ. Null is not empty; empty is a value.

items.topic: JUDO runtime exception hierarchy and HTTP mapping
items.claim: ValidationException in business-error docs as modeled/connected to attributes
items.fact: ClientException (abstract, RuntimeException; getStatusCode/getDetails, runtime-core exception package): ValidationException 400 (Collection<ValidationResult>), AccessDeniedException 403, AuthenticationRequiredException 401, NotFoundException 404 (single ValidationResult). ClientExceptionMapper returns getStatusCode (400 if null) with getDetails() JSON. BusinessException (judo-dispatcher-api, RuntimeException, NOT ClientException; fields type, errorCode, details, throwable, locale) -> 422 with header X-Fault:<type>, body {<faultFQN>:{details w/o '_' keys & nulls}, code:errorCode}; cause only if includeBusinessCause. InterceptorCallBusinessException extends BusinessException. Other exceptions -> 500 {level:ERROR, code:INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, details:{}}; stack trace details.exception when returnRuntimeExceptions (not for BusinessException). InternalServerException -> 500. There's no FeedbackItem class; equivalent is hu.blackbelt.judo.dao.api.ValidationResult (code, Level ERROR|WARNING, Object location, Map details).

items.topic: ValidationException is a platform exception; ValidationResult location need not be a model attribute
items.claim: Validation errors map to model attributes
items.fact: ValidationException is a platform ClientException, not generated. ValidationResult.location can be absent (DefaultDispatcher.java:305-309,320), free strings like '_mask'/'_identifier' (QueryCustomizerParameterProcessor.java:296,325), parameter name or '', or global access errors with only code/level (DefaultAccessManager.java:106-130).

items.topic: Modeled faults generate checked <Fault>Exception; dispatcher translates BusinessException
items.fact: dao.fault.java.hbs:8 generates <Fault>Exception extends java.lang.Exception (checked, not BusinessException) with typed details, errorCode as message, ctors (details),(errorCode,details),(errorCode,details,cause). dto.dispatcher.wrapper.java.hbs:43-54 catches BusinessException, matches ex.getType() to fault ASM name and throws <Fault>Exception, else IllegalStateException. DefaultDispatcher.java:408-414 creates BusinessException from operation result FAULT map (FAULT_TYPE, FAULT_DETAILS, FAULT_ERROR_CODE, FAULT_CAUSE).

items.topic: Dispatcher rewraps non-client RuntimeExceptions as InternalServerException; nested ClientException/BusinessException becomes 500
items.fact: DefaultDispatcher.java:812-814 rethrows ClientException and BusinessException unwrapped; every other RuntimeException/ExecutionException becomes InternalServerException('Operation failed', ex) (:815-816). No recursive getCause unwrapping in mappers or FaultInterceptor, so a client/business exception buried in a cause chain surfaces as generic 500. FaultInterceptor (CXF PRE_STREAM) only sets HTTP status, no body; auto-unboxes getStatusCode (NPE for null custom subclass).

items.topic: Business errors from interceptors must be wrapped in a business exception; ValidationException not for interceptors
items.claim: Docs tell interceptors to throw ValidationException/faults
items.fact: Operator: validation exceptions in business errors are not all modeled exceptions; a modeled fault can't be sent from interceptors; not all exceptions connect to model attributes because they don't come from the model; interceptors don't handle business problems, so the business error should be wrapped in the interceptor (e.g. InterceptorCallBusinessException/BusinessException). Operator asked for parallel exploration (5 explore subagents).
